title: Cast
description: Show project metrics on a Chromecast or Cast-enabled TV.
desktopRequired: Open the desktop app to cast
desktopDescription: Device discovery and Cast connections run in the SoulFire desktop app.
serverRequired: Connect to a SoulFire server before casting.
instanceDescription: Changing this selection does not change an active cast. Use Cast selected project to switch the display.
noDevices: No matching displays found. Check that the TV and desktop are on the same network, or enter an address below.
showDescription: Show on TV restarts the SoulFire receiver and restores its charts. Use it after returning to the TV home screen. Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+C for the first connected display.
invalidAddress: Enter an IP address or host name, such as 192.168.1.50.
manualNeedsInstance: Choose a project above before you connect.
settingsDescription: These settings apply to every display connected from this app.

errors.invalidState: The desktop app sent Cast data that this page cannot read. Restart SoulFire.
errors.sourceChanged: The server connection changed. Connect again.
errors.startFailed: Could not start casting. Check the connection settings.
errors.payloadTooLarge: The Cast message is larger than the receiver allows.
errors.sendFailed: Could not send the Cast message.
errors.receiverNoResponse: The Cast receiver did not respond.
errors.launchFailed: Could not start the SoulFire receiver on the display.
errors.receiverClosed: The Cast receiver closed the session.
errors.launchTimeout: The Cast receiver took too long to start.
errors.receiverStarting: The Cast receiver is still starting.
errors.incompatibleVersion: Update both SoulFire and the Cast receiver to compatible versions.
errors.metricsFailed: Could not get metrics from the SoulFire server.
